one_line_thought: 地図は、niche を薄くする。

source.source_documented_schedule: approximately one GPS location every 30 seconds
source.source_documented_native_event: latitude + longitude + GPS height above sea level + timestamp on the same GPS event
source.source_documented_raw_retention: archive includes data including points marked as outliers/removed by the source analysis

allowed_preflight_reads: study attribute names and data types
presence/non-missing count for a native GPS height field without reading its numeric distribution
timestamp interval counts and schedule-conformance summaries
x-y-only grid cell event and distinct-individual counts
forbidden_preflight_reads_or_outputs: GPS height mean, median, standard deviation or quantiles

schema_correction.basis: header-only checksum-pinned source inspection; zero data rows and zero numeric height values read

native_height_field_resolution_rule.if_multiple_present: select first field in frozen priority without reading values

allowed_schedule_outputs: number and fraction of consecutive within-individual intervals in 20-40 s

whole_individual_split.algorithm: sort unique individual identifiers by SHA256('odsp-n2-bat-v1|<individual>'); first ceil(0.25*n) are sealed

preflight_terminal_categories.bat_empirical_lane_structurally_unavaila: one or more frozen structural gates fail before any z distribution is read
preflight_terminal_categories.source_access_unavailable: the versioned/public source cannot be accessed reproducibly without changing the selected lane

post_preflight_rule.if_structurally_available: freeze a separate empirical thickness/answer-check contract before reading native height values
post_preflight_rule.if_unavailable: record terminal structural result; do not change dataset, grid, split or gates inside this lane
